item.title: Superior Girls Basketball Sees Season End in Regional Loss to Chippewa Falls
item.description: SUPERIOR, Wis.- The Superior girls basketball team began postseason play on Tuesday, facing Chippewa Falls in regional action. Unfortunately, the Cardinals proved to be too much as they took down the Spartans, 61 to 43. Superior finishes the year with a 5-20 overall record. Categories: High School, Sports

item.title: Carlson Tallies 2,000th Career Point in Proctor’s 1st Round Win Over Two Harbors
item.description: PROCTOR, Minn.- The Proctor girls basketball team extended their season on Tuesday, defeating Two Harbors 72 to 30 in the first round of the Section 7AA tournament. Chloe Carlson tallied her 2,000th career point in the victory. Proctor will next face Esko in the quarterfinals on Saturday in Cloquet.
